kebab_example: aliyun slb set-tls-cipher-policy-attribute --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --tls-cipher-policy-id tls-bp1lp2076qx4e000000bridp --name tls-policy00000-test --tls-versions TLSv1.0 --ciphers ECDHE-ECDSA-AES128-SHA --api-version 2014-05-15 --region cn-hangzhou
name: SetTLSCipherPolicyAttribute

parameters.help_en:
The region ID of the SLB instance.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/36063.html operation to query region IDs
parameters.help_zh:
负载均衡实例地域ID。

您可以通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/36063.html接口获取地域ID
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the TLS security policy
parameters.name: tls_cipher_policy_id

parameters.help_en: Policy Name of the TLS security policy. Policy Name must be 2 to 200 characters in length, and can contain letters, digits, periods (.), underscores (_), and hyphens (-). Policy Name must start with a letter
parameters.help_zh: TLS策略名称。长度为2~200个英文或中文字符，必须以大小字母或中文开头，可包含数字、半角句号（.）、下划线（_）和短划线（-）
parameters.name: name

parameters.help_en: The supported TLS protocol versions. Valid values: TLSv1.0, TLSv1.1, TLSv1.2, and TLSv1.3
parameters.name: tls_versions

parameters.help_en:
The supported cipher suites, which depend on the value of TLSVersions.

A cipher suite only needs to be supported by at least one of the specified TLS versions. For example, if TLSv1.3 is selected, the cipher suite list must contain at least one cipher suite supported by TLSv1.3.

TLSv1.0 and TLSv1.1 support:

ECDHE-ECDSA-AES128-SHA
ECDHE-ECDSA-AES256-SHA
ECDHE-RSA-AES128-SHA
ECDHE-RSA-AES256-SHA
AES128-SHA AES256-SHA
DES-CBC3-SHA

TLSv1.2 supports:

ECDHE-ECDSA-AES128-SHA
ECDHE-ECDSA-AES256-SHA
ECDHE-RSA-AES128-SHA
ECDHE-RSA-AES256-SHA
AES128-SHA AES256-SHA
DES-CBC3-SHA
ECDHE-ECDSA-AES128-GCM-SHA256
ECDHE-ECDSA-AES256-GCM-SHA384
ECDHE-ECDSA-AES128-SHA256
ECDHE-ECDSA-AES256-SHA384
ECDHE-RSA-AES128-GCM-SHA256
ECDHE-RSA-AES256-GCM-SHA384
ECDHE-RSA-AES128-SHA256
ECDHE-RSA-AES256-SHA384
AES128-GCM-SHA256
AES256-GCM-SHA384
AES128-SHA256 AES256-SHA256

TLSv1.3 supports:

TLS_AES_128_GCM_SHA256
TLS_AES_256_GCM_SHA384
TLS_CHACHA20_POLY1305_SHA256
TLS_AES_128_CCM_SHA256
TLS_AES_128_CCM_8_SHA256
